sources.description: According to The Athletic/Bleacher Report’s NFL insider James Palmer, the Denver Broncos are re-signing linebacker Justin Strnad to a three-year deal worth $18 million dollars with $10 million guaranteed. 9NEWS Denver’s Mike Klis has confirmed the James Palmer report.
